data.title: New classes crash the attendance page
story: 🔥 PRODUCTION INCIDENT: The function attendance_percent(records) takes a list of True (present) and False (absent), then works out the attendance percentage.
Normal classes are fine, but a new class with no attendance data yet crashes the page. For an empty list, the result must be 0.

explanation: Dividing by len([]), which is 0, raises a ZeroDivisionError. Add a guard at the start: if the list is empty, return 0 right away.
hints: Run the tests, then read the last line of the error for the empty list.
What is len(records) when the list is empty? What happens when you divide by it?
Add if len(records) == 0: return 0 before the division.
